机制概述: Rukyuk has 6 Ammo Tokens that give him different benefits on his attacks. He must use Ammo to hit with his attacks, so he must be careful when he uses which Ammo.

效果.效果: Use an Ammo. Explosive: +2 Power. Longshot: -1~+1 Range. AP: Ignore Armor. Swift: +2 Priority. Flash: Ignore Guard. Impact: Push 2.
